**Finding: deviation (Section 7.2, p0027)**

Section 7.2 imposes a most-favoured-nation obligation on us, not on Vendor: we would have to offer Vendor terms no less favourable than the best terms we offer any other technology supplier. It is unbounded — no defined product, no time limit, no reasonable-comparison carve-outs — so it fails the fallback and falls into walk-away territory. It also directly contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no most-favoured-customer commitment.

Redline (validated, preferred level): delete Section 7.2. No Vendor-granted MFN appears anywhere in the agreement, so deletion removes only the burden on us.
